# A clump of bath foam: faceted balls of three sizes, cream on top of sage. Origin at the water.
new
material new Foam --base-color 0.8235 0.7882 0.6471 --no-slot
material new FoamShade --base-color 0.5490 0.6706 0.6314 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name F0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.42 --location 0 0 0.12
material assign Foam
add mesh ico-sphere --name F1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.32 --location 0.5 0.2 0.08
material assign Foam
add mesh ico-sphere --name F2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.3 --location -0.45 0.25 0.06
material assign Foam
add mesh ico-sphere --name F3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.28 --location 0.2 -0.4 0.05
material assign Foam
add mesh ico-sphere --name F4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.24 --location -0.25 -0.35 0.04
material assign FoamShade
add mesh ico-sphere --name F5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0.75 -0.2 0.02
material assign FoamShade
add mesh ico-sphere --name F6 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.26 --location 0.1 0.1 0.4
material assign Foam
select all
shade flat
export foam.glb
